name: Jonah
bio: Jonah son of Amittai, of Gath Hepher, was a prophet of the LORD. During the reign of Jeroboam (son of Jehoash), king of Israel, Jonah had prophesied that the LORD would restore Israel's border from Lebo Hamath to the Sea of the Arabah; the LORD fulfilled this through Jeroboam, out of compassion for Israel's bitter affliction rather than willingness to blot out Israel's name (2 Kings 14:25-27). His own remarkable story — called to preach to Nineveh, fleeing by sea, swallowed by a great fish, and wrestling with God's mercy toward a foreign city — is told in detail in the book that bears his name.
